title: PixelKin - Kindled! (success fanfare)
_note: One-shot, ~4 s incl. ring-out: plays the moment the bloom clears and the new kin is revealed. Answers the ceremony's A-minor tension by breaking into its relative C major — the light caught. A bouncing climb (the kin standing up in its new shape), a proud two-beat turn on F -> G, and a firm landing home with a bell sparkle (the Light signature). Deliberately different contour from the Gleam fanfare (which rises on the Vesper motif): this one leaps and dances.
